scope: Removes the failed secure-session handoff from the active Login page
Restores direct routing after a valid Supabase password login so Admin and Member access work again
Retains Supabase-only authentication, HealthyMe role validation, single-step logout and stale role-recovery cleanup
Treats browser refresh persistence as unresolved rather than blocking login
Stops further iframe and CookieManager persistence patches pending a standards-based OIDC implementation
known_limitations: A full browser refresh may require a fresh login until the Supabase OIDC replacement is implemented
The H13C durable session table remains in Supabase but is not accepted as the active browser-persistence mechanism
excluded: No Flutter or Admin Lite code change
No assessment, report, recommendation, schedule or member-data contract change
